profile.headline: Software Engineer | Backend & API Development | Systems Design | Developer Productivity
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer who enjoys turning complex business requirements into reliable, maintainable software. My work spans the entire development lifecycle—from investigating production issues and collaborating with stakeholders to designing solutions, implementing features, reviewing code, and supporting applications in production.

I primarily build backend services and APIs, with experience delivering large-scale public sector applications used by courts, probation departments, and justice agencies nationwide. I enjoy simplifying complex systems, improving existing codebases, and creating solutions that remain understandable and maintainable as they evolve.

I believe good software is more than working code. Clear communication, thoughtful design, predictable delivery, and knowledge sharing are just as important as implementation. I regularly collaborate with cross-functional teams, participate in code reviews, mentor developers, and contribute to engineering practices that improve long-term team productivity and software quality.

My technical background includes Python, PHP, TypeScript, Java, SQL, REST APIs, and modern web frameworks, with extensive experience building data-driven applications and integrating across complex business domains. I’m particularly interested in software architecture, developer productivity, and building systems that reduce cognitive overhead while remaining understandable, maintainable, and reliable over time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain a multi-tenant case management platform supporting probation and justice agencies across multiple U.S. states. My work spans legacy and modern services, with a focus on backend development, reporting systems, integrations, security, and long-term maintainability.

Highlights

* Deliver backend services, APIs, reporting workflows, and integrations across PHP, Symfony/API Platform, Vue, MySQL, and PostgreSQL applications.
* Drive cross-service initiatives from requirements through implementation, including third-party integrations, data modeling, secure credential management, and scheduled processing.
* Steward configurable reporting and document-generation systems used to support complex operational and compliance workflows.
* Improve application performance and reliability through query optimization, production issue investigation, targeted refactoring, and comprehensive automated testing.
* Contribute to security and data-protection initiatives, including input validation, tenant isolation, secure credential handling, and defense-in-depth improvements.
* Regularly review and approve merge requests across the engineering team, providing implementation feedback and helping maintain code quality and consistency.
* Collaborate with product owners, QA, and fellow engineers to translate evolving business and regulatory requirements into maintainable software solutions.

Technologies

PHP • Symfony • API Platform • Vue.js • MySQL • PostgreSQL • Redis • Docker • GitLab CI • PHPUnit • AWS
